title: Starmind: SpaceX's plan for up to 1 million AI satellites
subtitle: What SpaceX put in writing, and what it showed at the International Astronautical Congress.
title_narration: Starmind. SpaceX's plan for up to one million A.I. satellites.
as_of: Grounded in Jim's Interest Journal research for Oct 1 and Oct 6, 2026. Concept details are SpaceX's own and may change.

scenes.label: In writing
scenes.heading: A new SpaceX Space Safety page sets the scale
scenes.caption: A new SpaceX Space Safety page says it plans to operate up to 100,000 Starlink satellites and up to 1 million Starmind AI satellites.
evidence: plans to operate up to 100,000 Starlink satellites and up to 1 million Starmind AI satellites.

scenes.label: How it computes
scenes.heading: Compute would run in *clusters*
scenes.caption: At the International Astronautical Congress, SpaceX's Michael Nicolls said compute would run in clusters of 10-ish satellites, with about 10 Tbps of links between them. Each could weigh up to 4,000 kg.
evidence: compute would run in clusters of "10-ish satellites" with about 10 Tbps of links between them
Each satellite could weigh up to 4,000 kg.

scenes.label: The first look

data.who: Michael Nicolls, SpaceX, on the first Starmind video

scenes.caption: SpaceX also showed the first visual of the constellation. Nicolls called the video a very notional concept, and probably wrong.
evidence: showed the first visual of the constellation
called the video "a very notional concept... probably wrong."

scenes.label: Power
scenes.heading: Each spacecraft out-powers the space station

cards.label: of solar power on each Star Mind spacecraft
more than the International Space Station

scenes.caption: Elon Musk's pinned post on October 1 said each Star Mind spacecraft will have over 250kW of solar power, about 20% more than the International Space Station.
evidence: Each @SpaceX Star Mind super intelligence spacecraft will have over 250kW of solar power, which is about 20% more than the International Space Station

scenes.label: What's next
scenes.heading: From concept video to orbit

events.label: Up to 1 million Starmind satellites, in writing

scenes.caption: Nicolls said the first Starmind satellites launch next year. Retired satellites would go to heliocentric graveyard orbits rather than reentering the atmosphere.
evidence: He said the first Starmind satellites launch next year
Retired satellites would go to heliocentric "graveyard" orbits rather than reentering the atmosphere.

scenes.label: The pushback
scenes.heading: Not everyone is cheering

lines: Same day, Starlink said other operators' undisclosed maneuvers are *"the biggest risk in LEO."*

scenes.caption: Astronomers are objecting. The same day, Starlink said other operators' undisclosed maneuvers are the biggest risk in LEO.
